task: Apply CSF (Cloth Simulation Filter) ground segmentation to /home/user/Documents/scene.ply (2500 points, ASCII). Classify points into ground and non-ground using default CSF parameters. Export only the ground points as an ASCII PLY at /home/user/Documents/ground.ply. The output should contain only points classified as ground.
